summary: Comprehensive testing of Healthcare Super-app UI/UX overhaul. All requested features verified: Portal cards with brand colors, My Cura pastel gradient Health Tools (2x2 grid), new pages (PrescriptionScanner, MedicineReminders, FamilyHealth), DiaGyn branding badge, Bottom Nav tabs, Book FAB expansion, and Doctor Search advanced filters. Backend APIs tested and functioning correctly.

All new pages load correctly: /prescription-scanner (upload area, camera btn, how it works), /medicine-reminders (login prompt for unauth), /family-health (self card, add member, info banner). Portal cards have correct brand colors (Evara purple #56186c, Glydex navy #0f083b, Reneu gray #f7f7f7, ALYNE blue #001639). DiaGyn shows 'A Nevika Cura Company' teal badge. Doctor Search has rating filter (Any/3+/3.5+/4+/4.5+), Available Today toggle, and Sort By options.
